info.title: Ultiwrite API
info.description:
Ultiwrite is operated by DWS Offshore Fund dba Ultiwrite. Ultiwrite examines the documents and evidence behind opportunities, organizations, counterparties, acquisitions, financings and portfolios, and returns released findings: source economics, document integrity, material contradictions, unresolved claims and the next diligence move. The API never renders an autonomous approve or decline.

Partner API (dashboard API key or OAuth 2.1): explicitly approved accounts submit evidence, continue asynchronous processing and read the released report. Polling uses API requests but no additional analysis credits. Reports are never assumed to be immediate.

Provisioned routes authenticate with a separately admin-issued uw_live_ API key. Their request, response and error schemas describe their existing public behavior; ordinary Partner keys and OAuth tokens do not authorize these routes.

Versioning: the major version is in the path (/api/v1). Within v1, changes are additive; a field or operation is removed only after a deprecation notice in this document (deprecated: true) and the changelog. Response header Ultiwrite-Api-Version identifies the contract revision.

API access requires an explicit administrator grant, independent of paid plan. Monthly and fixed-minute request limits are pooled across every key and partner OAuth grant on the account. Every admitted request, including polling and authenticated validation errors, uses one request; failed authentication and quota denials do not. Analysis credits use the existing separate ledger. Exceeding a limit returns 429 with Retry-After.

Dashboard keys support read_only (ultiwrite:read) and investigator (read plus evidence) roles. Customer key monthly and per-minute caps only reduce account allowances; a monthly key cap of0 pauses that key. Omitted or null key caps follow the pooled account policy. Key roles are immutable; rotate a replacement key to change its permissions. API keys never grant staff or optional checkout authority.

Released report artifacts are downloadable with this Partner API bearer under /reports/{reportId}/artifacts/{artifact}. Read-only keys can retrieve entitled JSON, commercial PDF, issued document-forensics PDF, CSV, Excel and ZIP. Existing MCP and native-client delivery boundaries are unchanged; tokens must target this exact Partner API resource.

get.description: Partner API bearer delivery using the same saved customer publication, tenant check, export entitlements, renderers and volume limits as website downloads. Read-only keys work. The original credential, current account API approval, publication revision and export permissions are rechecked after preparation. One admitted request, no new analysis credit. MCP-resource tokens and native-client-only grants do not authorize this resource. JSON uses the existing commercial customer projection. ZIP includes the requested complete formats and ordered volumes. No presigned URL or shareable access is issued.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
# Single request; no automatic mutation replay. Set TOKEN, REPORT_ID, ARTIFACT in the process environment. Save/resume returned IDs; use the downloadable workflow client for polling, staged uploads and recovery.
: "${TOKEN:?Set TOKEN}"
: "${REPORT_ID:?Set REPORT_ID}"
: "${ARTIFACT:?Set ARTIFACT}"
# A new output directory prevents overwriting an earlier response.
out=$(mktemp -d ./ultiwrite-response.XXXXXX)
success=0
trap 'if [[ "$success" != 1 ]]; then rm -f "$out/response.bin"; fi' EXIT
status=$(curl --silent --show-error --fail --proto '=https' --max-redirs 0 \
  --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 --request GET \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --header 'Accept: application/json, application/octet-stream' \
  --output "$out/response.bin" --write-out '%{http_code}' "https://dwsoffshorepartners.com/api/v1/reports/$(jq -rn --arg v "$REPORT_ID" '$v|@uri')/artifacts/$(jq -rn --arg v "$ARTIFACT" '$v|@uri')")
[[ "$status" == 2?? ]] || { echo "HTTP $status" >&2; exit 1; }
success=1
printf 'Saved response in %s/response.bin\n' "$out"

# Single request; no automatic mutation replay. Set TOKEN, REPORT_ID, ARTIFACT in the process environment. Save/resume returned IDs; use the downloadable workflow client for polling, staged uploads and recovery.
require 'net/http'; require 'uri'; require 'securerandom'; require 'tmpdir'
def env(name); ENV.fetch(name) { raise 'Set '+name }; end
uri=URI("https://dwsoffshorepartners.com/api/v1/reports/" + URI.encode_www_form_component(env('REPORT_ID')).gsub('+','%20') + "/artifacts/" + URI.encode_www_form_component(env('ARTIFACT')).gsub('+','%20') + "")
request=Net::HTTPGenericRequest.new('GET',false,true,uri.request_uri)
request['Authorization']='Bearer '+env('TOKEN')
request['Accept']='application/json, application/octet-stream'
request['Accept-Encoding']='identity'

http=Net::HTTP.new(uri.host,uri.port);http.use_ssl=true;http.open_timeout=15;http.read_timeout=120;http.write_timeout=120;http.max_retries=0
begin
  http.request(request) do |response|
    raise 'HTTP '+response.code unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    directory=Dir.mktmpdir('ultiwrite-response-','.')
    expected=response['Content-Length'];count=0
    raise 'Invalid response length' if expected && !expected.match?(/\A[0-9]+\z/)
    begin
      File.open(directory+'/response.bin',File::WRONLY|File::CREAT|File::EXCL,0600) do |output|
        response.read_body { |chunk| output.write(chunk);count+=chunk.bytesize }
      end
      raise 'Incomplete response' if expected && count!=expected.to_i
    rescue Exception
      File.unlink(directory+'/response.bin') if File.exist?(directory+'/response.bin')
      raise
    end
    puts 'Saved response in '+directory+'/response.bin'
  end
ensure
  # No automatic redirects or mutation retries.
end

post.description:
Creates one case from one evidence package (1 to 6 files) and runs the canonical analysis workflow inside this request’s execution budget. The response reports the saved workflow state; it is complete only when a report was saved. Otherwise poll the case and follow its continue link. Uses one analysis from the account allowance when the report is saved; a failed analysis is not charged.

Idempotency: Content-addressed. The same files (by SHA-256 and name) with the same documentForensics choice always map to the same case in the organization; retries return it with state already_persisted and use no additional analysis credit. Each admitted HTTP request still counts toward the API request allowance. No Idempotency-Key header is needed.
